measurement.fresh_process_note: Two fresh processes with different PYTHONHASHSEED produced byte-identical goldens (sha256 3534fe6c463e1bb3f6eab154f8a266952876378e71b649b4a665a46a3e686426); --check likewise passes.
measurement.full_training_set_budget_note: Measured pure-numpy kernel cost: ~28 ms per training atom (15.1 s for train[:512], 29.1 s for train[:1024]), i.e. ~25 min per query atom against the full 53208-atom atomic_reps.gz. The FCHL candidate layer therefore uses the first 32 training atoms / first 64 folded residuals; layers 1-3 anchor the full-precision descriptor, real training-slice kernel and full-residual KDE separately.
measurement.freeze_policy: Every layer's observed repeat deviation is exactly 0.0; the frozen rtol=1e-12 is ~4500x float64 eps and orders of magnitude tighter than any decision-relevant layer signal (descriptor neighbour terms 1e-3..8, kernel values spanning 1e-200..1, KDE/probabilities 0.06..0.88). Tolerances were NOT relaxed to make the final probability agree: lower layers carry the tighter absolute floor (1e-300) because a descriptor/kernel regression must fail on its own assertion before the candidate probability is even reached. Any re-freeze must re-run the measurement above and update this block.

descriptor_c0.note: Pure float64 descriptor construction; 1e-300 is only an underflow-boundary floor (padding 1e100 is code-constant and covered relatively).

kernel_numpy_query_train32.note: Real training-slice kernel (first 32 atoms of the pinned atomic_reps.gz); values span 3.3e-200..8.9e-05 with exact underflow zeros; rtol catches relative drift, the floor only rescues literal 0-vs-subnormal boundary cases.

kernel_numpy_self4.note: Training atoms vs themselves; self-kernel diagonal is exactly 1.0 and the remaining entries pin the alchemy/cut terms.

kernel_qml.note: Provisional bound: no qml environment was available at freeze time, so compiled-vs-numpy parity was NOT measured and is skipped with an explicit NOT_VERIFIED reason. When qml becomes importable, run the layer, record the observed deviation, and re-freeze this entry; do not treat the current bound as verified.

kde_weighted_fixed.note: Weighted Gaussian KDE over the full checked-in folded_scaled_errors.p (106416 residuals) with fixed linspace(0.001, 1.0) weights via patched kernel seam; independent of kernel-layer correctness by construction.

kde_zero_weight_fallback.note: sum(K_sim)==0 branch (DP5.py:98) — unweighted global KDE over the same residual set.

probability_per_conformer.note: Public GoodmanDP5Model seam on the full checked-in assets; per-conformer scaling + Boltzmann-averaged atom probabilities + gmean + Bayesian rescale.

probability_single.note: Simplified single-residual-set seam (KDE on already-averaged inputs).

probability_per_conformer_fchl_reduced32.note: FCHL-weighting pipeline on the pinned 32-atom training slice (see measurement.full_training_set_budget_note); backend pinned to the numpy port for determinism — qml parity is the kernel_qml layer.
